evidence.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India

summary: OpenAI will begin displaying advertisements to users of its free and Go subscription plans for ChatGPT in India, marking the company's first foray into ad-supported AI chat services. The move aims to generate additional revenue while keeping basic access to the chatbot affordable.
title: OpenAI Announces Ads on Free and Go ChatGPT Tiers in India
